prompt:
FANTASY MASTER REFERENCE FIRST: @Video1 is the master reference for the style, mood and characters of this whole clip, and it already shows Mai running through the inside of the fantasy gate (the teal tunnel of floating monitors). Match its render look, materials, colour palette, lighting mood, atmosphere, character design, proportions and animation feel on every frame.

[Generation Goal] 5 seconds, 1 continuous shot, no cuts, 16:9, real-time 24 fps, no slow motion. A very HIGH, near top-down camera inside the fantasy gate looking steeply DOWN onto the tunnel floor: Mai, small, runs FAST along the path from the TOP of the frame DOWN toward the BOTTOM of the frame (coming out of the bright light at the far end toward the camera side), seen from above. Clean air around her: NO smoke, NO dust and NO mist trail behind her or under her feet.

[References] @Video1: style, world and this tunnel. @Image1: the INSIDE of the fantasy gate, this IS the location: a long cyan-teal tunnel whose walls and ceiling are made of dark twisted roots and cables, with many floating glowing white and pale-teal monitors drifting in the air along the walls; a path runs down its middle. @Image2 = MAI ONLY (design only, re-render in Mai's 3D style): girl about 11, slim, fair skin, chin-length straight black BOB with full bangs, a small yellow hair clip; white short-sleeve school shirt with a navy sailor-style collar, a red neckerchief; navy pleated skirt; white sneakers; light sky-blue backpack.

[Style Lock] ONE single render style for every character and creature: exactly the premium stylized 3D CG look of @Video1 and of Mai as she appears in @Video1. The character reference images are DESIGN ONLY (face shape, hair, costume, colours, props); many of them are drawn in other styles (pencil sketch, watercolour, flat 2D, outlined illustration, paper texture): IGNORE their drawing style completely and never copy outlines, sketch lines, watercolour washes, flat shading or paper grain. Re-render every person as a 3D character from the same film as Mai: the same proportion system and stylisation (rounded soft volumes, slightly large expressive eyes with catchlights, small nose, simplified features), the same skin shading and subsurface warmth, the same cloth and hair materials, the same lighting response, film grain and level of detail. Adults stay adult proportions (7-7.5 heads) but share Mai's stylisation. Nobody may look like a different art style, a 2D drawing, a realistic human or a different film.

[Head Count] EXACTLY 1 person in this clip. Nobody else exists in this clip: no wolf, no villains, no other people, no animals.
1. Mai (@Image2): small, seen from above, running fast from the top of the frame down toward the bottom.

[No Blending] Mai (@Image2) keeps only her own school uniform and sky-blue backpack; nothing from the tunnel merges into her.

[Composition, LOCKED to the reference frame] Very HIGH camera up near the tunnel ceiling, looking steeply DOWN at the floor (about 70-75 degrees down, almost top-down), 35 mm: the dark root-and-cable tunnel walls frame the LEFT and RIGHT thirds of the frame and curve together above like a dark vignette; a vertical band of light runs down the centre of the frame: the floor path, bright and pale cyan-teal near the top of the frame where the tunnel ends in a bright glow, darker near the bottom. Floating monitors glow along both walls, a few drifting in the air above the path. Mai (@Image2) is SMALL (about one eighth of the frame height), seen from high above: mostly the top of her black bob, her shoulders and the straps of her sky-blue backpack, her arms and quick legs; she runs DOWN the frame, from the bright upper part of the path toward the bottom of the frame; the light is behind her, so her long thin shadow runs ahead of her DOWN the frame toward the bottom edge. The air around her is clear.

[Action & Camera, time-ordered]
Shot 1 (0-5 s), 1 person visible (Mai, small, from high above): ONE high backward glide of the camera along the tunnel ceiling, in the same direction Mai runs but a little SLOWER than her, keeping the same steep top-down angle, so Mai travels down the frame. 0-1 s: Mai appears in the bright upper part of the path, in the upper third of the frame, already running fast toward the bottom of the frame; 1-4 s: she runs FAST straight down the path through the centre of the frame, quick light steps, backpack and hair bouncing hard with each stride, her shadow racing ahead of her; floating monitors stream past quickly along both walls; 4-5 s: she reaches the lower third of the frame, still running fast. Her feet touch a clean floor: no smoke, no dust, no mist kicked up anywhere.

[Running Style] Mai runs the way a small, delicate little girl runs: graceful, soft and light, a little prim, not sporty. Small, dainty, bouncy steps landing lightly almost on her toes, feet close together; her lower legs flick outward to the SIDES behind her with each step; knees close together; upper body upright, shoulders soft; elbows bent and tucked in at her waist, forearms a little out to the sides, hands loose and floppy at the wrist, fluttering side to side rather than forward and back; hips and shoulders sway gently; hair and skirt bounce softly with every little step; but FAST now: quick, urgent little steps, a light girl in a hurry, still not an athlete.

[Acting] Mai: frightened but determined, hurrying, running fast, glancing back over her shoulder once toward the light behind her. Classic animation principles: weight in each step, follow-through on her hair, skirt and backpack.

[Character Look] Mai's skin is fair and light as in the reference; the teal light only tints her rim.
[Expression] Not readable from this height; no screaming.

[Lighting] Dark tunnel; a strong cool pale-cyan light pours from the far end of the tunnel (top of the frame, behind Mai) down the path, casting Mai's long shadow ahead of her toward the bottom of the frame; soft teal glow from the floating monitors along the walls; deep shadows in the root walls.

[Visual Style] Exactly the style of @Video1 (premium stylized 3D animated feature film, matte materials, fine film grain, slight bloom). Child 6-6.5 heads tall. 16:9, real-time 24 fps.

[Audio] Sound effects and ambience only: Mai's light quick footsteps echoing in the tunnel, her soft hurried breathing, the deep electric hum of the tunnel, fast whooshes of monitors rushing past, a low distant rumble. NO music, NO score, NO song, NO singing, NO melody, no dialogue.

[Avoid] smoke, steam, mist, dust or a vapour trail behind Mai, under her feet or anywhere along the path; a white plume or column of smoke; the wolf, villains, other people; any text, letters, numbers, subtitles, timecode, captions, scene labels or logos anywhere, including on the monitors; faces on the monitors; Mai large or close to camera; an eye-level or low angle; Mai running up the frame or away from the bottom edge; Mai's face in close view; slow motion, freeze frame; cuts or a second shot; mixed art styles, 2D or sketch-like characters, realistic photographic humans; athletic or sprinter running, pumping arms; hoodie, chibi; dark or grey skin; studio or film names.
